name: Osage National Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from opengolfapi, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. review.why: safe to publish with the hole-1 Palmer tee fix; hole 3 Palmer flagged uncertain (Tournament set is clean on every hole)
